name: apple-mail-mcp
description: Fast Apple Mail access for Claude — full-coverage FTS5 body search, disk-first reads, plus flag/color and read/unread write tools.
long_description: Apple Mail MCP gives Claude fast, reliable access to your macOS Mail: full-coverage FTS5 body search (no recency cap), ~3ms disk-first single-email reads via .emlx parsing, and batch listing across accounts and mailboxes. This build also adds the first write tools — flag/unflag single emails or batches with Apple Mail's seven flag colors, and mark messages read (seen) or unread (unseen). Write tools return per-id result buckets so a batch never fails as a whole, and honor read-only mode and account-exclusion boundaries. The bundle is a thin launcher: it runs the Python server via `uvx` (uv required) and fetches the code from the public GitHub fork, so no Python is bundled. This is a fork of imdinu/apple-mail-mcp (GPL-3.0) tracking the write-ops branch; not affiliated with or endorsed by Apple Inc.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: List all configured email accounts in Apple Mail.

tools.name: get_emails
tools.description: List emails from a mailbox, filtered by all/unread/flagged/today/last_7_days. account="all" lists across every visible account in one call.

tools.name: get_email
tools.description: Get a single email — or a list of up to 50 in one call — with full content, attachments, flag colour and its current account/mailbox, by stable Message-ID or numeric id.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Full-text search across accounts — subject, sender, body, or attachment filenames.

tools.name: get_email_attachment
tools.description: Extract a file attachment from an email to disk.

tools.name: get_attachment
tools.description: Deprecated alias — use get_email_attachment or get_email_links.

tools.name: set_flag
tools.description: Write — flag or unflag one email or a batch, optionally by color (red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple, gray). Takes stable Message-ID headers, so it keeps working after the mail is moved from a phone.

tools.name: set_read_status
tools.description: Write — mark one email or a batch read (seen) or unread (unseen). Takes stable Message-ID headers, so it keeps working after the mail is moved from a phone.

tools.name: get_index_status
tools.description: Index health, build progress and setup diagnostics — the server's only reachable diagnostic channel.

tools.name: refresh_index
tools.description: Update or completely rebuild this server's mail search index (not Apple Mail's own index).

auto_update.title: Automatic updates
auto_update.description: Check for a newer build once a day when the extension starts. Failures never block startup — the last working build is used.

auto_build_index.title: Build the search index automatically
auto_build_index.description: On — needs Full Disk Access for Claude (System Settings > Privacy & Security), and the index builds itself. Off — grant no disk access and build it yourself with 'apple-mail-mcp index' in Terminal; search then reads that index. Flagging and read/unread work either way.

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: Disable the write tools (set_flag, set_read_status). Reading and searching stay available.

default_account.title: Default account
default_account.description: Optional. Account name to use when a request doesn't name one (e.g. "Work"). Leave empty to use the first account in Mail.

exclude_accounts.title: Hidden accounts
exclude_accounts.description: Optional. Comma-separated account names to hide completely — never indexed, searched, read, or written (exact, case-sensitive).

source_ref.title: Source (advanced)
source_ref.description: Which build to run. Leave empty for the default branch build. Advanced: a uv requirement such as "apple-mail-mcp" (PyPI) or a git ref.
